The objective of this request is to obtain a rental agreement to furnish a rental chiller unit with the capabilities to supply 200 Tons of cooling for the Parker Indian Health Center. Unit must be Air Cooled due to the facility does not have a cooling tower system. Provide all necessary tools, labor, and training to connect temporary chiller to existing system.
